evals.name: support-question-stops-before-code
evals.prompt: Assess petdex issue #707. The body only asks how to move the pet. Decide what the factory should do next.
evals.expected_output: A read-only question-support assessment recommends support-response-v1, cites the question as evidence, preserves unknowns, and forbids implementation and promotion.
assertions: Stops for human confirmation without invoking solution-gate

evals.name: ambiguous-bug-remains-read-only
evals.prompt: Assess an issue whose entire report is: The app crashes sometimes. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: An unverified-bug assessment uses low confidence, lists missing reproduction context, and recommends bug-reproduction-v1 rather than implementation.
assertions: Records missing reproduction details as unknowns
Does not authorize a code change

evals.name: existing-pr-routes-to-review
evals.prompt: Assess PR #91 at head 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789 and tell me whether the factory should implement the request.
evals.expected_output: A pull-request-review assessment preserves the exact head SHA, recommends pull-request-review-v1, and forbids implementation of a competing change.
assertions: Routes findings to successor work instead of editing the PR
